QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `library/threading.c` is wholly gated on it (lines 18–193), so every lock site in the library is `#if`'d out. ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` also default off

VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C as the gate for threading.c, and it names MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD alongside it as a related threading macro. The mutex code is described as compiled out when these are off.
